scripts.docker: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up && npm run docker:logs
scripts.github:secrets: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && gh secret set DOT_ENV --repo "$GH_REPO" < .env
scripts.github:remote: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && git remote add origin "$GH_REPO"
scripts.github:deploy: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && npm run github:secrets && git -c "credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential" push origin HEAD
scripts.eas:initialize: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && export EXPO_TOKEN="$EAS_TOKEN" && npx --yes eas-cli init
scripts.eas:deploy: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && export EXPO_TOKEN="$EAS_TOKEN" && npm run expo:build && npx --yes eas-cli deploy --non-interactive --prod --export-dir build
